MetricAlarms.AlarmDescription: AUD-F-12/E6.2: chat-api's OTel collector failed to export - product KPIs are not reaching CloudWatch. Consequence: the twenty-two SPEC 5.32.4 KPIs stop arriving; dashboards keep rendering and simply stop advancing, which reads as 'nobody used the product' rather than as a fault. The collector is `essential: false` on purpose, so nothing else will tell you and the API stays healthy throughout. Check the `otel-collector` log stream in the service's log group at this timestamp; the EMF record carries `service_instance_id` if one task is at fault.
